Chapter 734: Chapter 25: The Silent Xia Qin Supreme Being (Please Subscribe)

Virtual World.

Nalan curiously asked, “Galaxy Master, in the Two-dimensional World, you must have entered the Witch Ancestor Realm, right?”

Lin Yuan was the greatest genius in human civilization history, with an undisputedly brilliant aptitude; thus, Nalan was almost certain Lin Yuan had become a Witch Ancestor.

It is known that in the Two-dimensional World for over a hundred years, a significant number of Tenth Rank lives have only just entered the Witch Ancestor Realm.

At the initial advent in the Two-dimensional World, Eighth Layer life, Ninth Rank life, Tenth Rank life, and Eleventh-Rank life all started at the same point.

But as time elapsed, the disparities between them began to widen, and the gaps continued to grow.

...

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded, “Witch Ancestor Eighteenth Realm, that is still a Witch Ancestor.”

“In that case, our human civilization’s Eleventh-Rank Evolvers have compiled seventeen methods of cultivation for stages beyond the Witch Ancestor Realm; I’ll send them to you to see.”

Nalan immediately sent them to Lin Yuan.

In the Two-dimensional World, where special life forms prevail, and human civilization is relatively weak, it is crucial to stay united.

Sharing cultivation methods with each other is a norm, and as for the competition when the Sky Gate opens… as long as the majority of those who leave the Two-dimensional World are human Evolvers, then human civilization would be considered victorious.

However, the prospect doesn’t look great at the moment.

Not to mention those hidden figures like the mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country—just the Four Divine Kings alone have almost guaranteed their spots for leaving during the first Sky Gate opening.

“Thank you.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the cultivation methods Nalan had sent over, his expression pensive.

The creators of these post-Witch Ancestor cultivation methods were essentially Eleventh-Rank beings of human civilization, each an outstanding genius of their era, and their explored cultivation methods significantly moved Lin Yuan.

They moved him more than those native Witch Ancestor cultivation methods from the Two-dimensional World.

“It’s just that my cultivation method might not suit you guys…” Lin Yuan looked up at Nalan after skimming through the texts, his voice hesitant.

The Witch Ancestor Cultivation Skill Lin Yuan was practicing was developed using his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, tailored to his conditions.

The advantage is that it could tap into the potential of every stage of his physical development, but the downside…it was uniquely suited to Lin Yuan himself; other powerhouses could not emulate it even if they wanted to.

In fact, the multiple post-Witch Ancestor cultivation methods that Nalan had compiled were also explored and developed by many Tier 11 Evolvers based on their conditions.

They also didn’t have any universal applicability, but Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, could observe these methods from the most fundamental perspective.

“Don’t worry.”

Nalan shook his head, “Although Lin Yuan, you’re the greatest genius in human civilization history, you’re still just a Tenth Rank life; compared to Eleventh-Rank Evolvers, your perspective is narrower and closer.”

“Once this Sky Gate opens, I will specifically organize some cultivation methods for you all,” Lin Yuan said thoughtfully.

For now, the most important task for him was to enhance his strength as much as possible before the Sky Gate opened in two hundred years.

Creating specialized cultivation methods for other human Evolvers would be a deviation from his goals.

Such a task could wait till two hundred years later.

By then, Lin Yuan should have more free time.

…

Deep underground.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his presence undulating like a fathomless abyss.

At a certain moment.

Lin Yuan, like a steadfast rock emitting no aura, then suddenly erupted like a tsunami, horrifying fluctuations of vital energy spreading in all directions.

If not for being underground, the disturbance could have alarmed countless Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses within thousands of miles.

“Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm…”

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes, his face breaking into a slight smile.

After reviewing other Eleventh-Rank Evolver’s explored paths in Witch Ancestor cultivation from human civilization, Lin Yuan’s own accumulation had finally reached a qualitative breakthrough, advancing into the Witch Ancestor’s Nineteenth Realm.

“My current power is sixty percent stronger than in the Witch Ancestor Eighteenth Realm. To hunt down Tuoba Ancient God again, it would take no more than two hours to penetrate his mystical inner armor and kill him.”

Lin Yuan felt the surged strength within his body, satisfied with the result.

“I wonder how strong the Four Divine Kings are now?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. The Four Divine Kings possessed supreme weapons perfectly suited to them,

Under such circumstances, utilizing these supreme weapons to comprehend the force of this world would likely far surpass other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

“It’s time to go back.”

Lin Yuan stood up and left the depths of the underground, heading back to the Luochuan gathering area.

…

Luochuan gathering area.

Zha Ran Gu stood there respectfully.

“Master,”

Zha Ran Gu spoke respectfully.

Just now, Zha Ran Gu had again received news from Xueyu Tavern, and the source of the rampant bloody traces within Xueyu Ancient Country had been completely resolved.

According to Xueyu Tavern, a certain supreme powerhouse within Xueyu Ancient Country had acted to suppress a group of powerhouses causing slaughter within the country.

Xueyu Tavern knew nothing about this supreme powerhouse, but Zha Ran Gu faintly realized, could this be related to Lin Yuan?

Especially since this great battle coincided with Lin Yuan’s disappearance,

And the matter had occurred after he had discussed it with Lin Yuan?

Thinking of the terrifying traces on the battleground reported by Xueyu Tavern, Zha Ran Gu couldn’t help but shiver.

Could that truly be the power a person could possess?

“I need to continue my closed-door cultivation.”

“Unless it’s something important, there’s no need to disturb me,”

Lin Yuan glanced at Zha Ran Gu, instructing him.

The changes in Zha Ran Gu’s emotions were clear as daylight in Lin Yuan’s eyes.

But Lin Yuan didn’t care. Even if the identity of that mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country were exposed, how would it matter if it were revealed to be him?

Currently, his identity in the Luochuan Gathering Place has no connection whatsoever with his identity as the Milky Way Galaxy Master in the Main Universe.

If it’s exposed, so be it.

Moreover, Lin Yuan did not believe Zha Ran Gu would dare to spread their suspicions.

…

In a world where Phantasm Reality alternated.

Nine breaths surged out, forming nine towering figures, precisely the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

“With our human civilization’s heritage treasure, ‘Void Realm World,’ to replicate that Two-dimensional World, even if it’s only ten to twenty percent similar, It’s enough for us to deduce the cultivation methods,” said the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

The sheet from the Taiyuan Relic was unfathomable, and even a Supreme Being dared not let themselves be drawn into it, risking a plunge into that two-dimensional world.

But it doesn’t mean there are no methods if Supreme Beings dare not risk it personally.

For instance, human civilization could use the ‘Void Realm World,’ simulate the two-dimensional world within the sheet, which allows Supreme Beings to enter and perceive its fundamental power.

‘Void Realm World’ is one of the heritages of human civilization, capable of replicating and simulating the myriad rules of the Main Universe.

Indeed, the two-dimensional world within the sheet completely retracted without giving away much aura; however, the treasure of human civilization ‘Void Realm World’ can still replicate it through the little aura available.

The two-dimensional world replicated by ‘Void Realm World’ naturally can’t compare to the real one, with a similarity of only about ten to twenty percent.

But that’s enough.

Supreme Beings can enter at will, and from the height of Ultimate beings, even a one percent degree of similarity can help deduce many things.

“Hmph.”

“That old monster from the Star Alliance has merged a Supreme Weapon into that youngster of the Four Divine Kings, rendering him nearly invincible in the two-dimensional world.”

“Now we have utilized the ‘Void Realm World,’ to deduce the cultivation methods for our human civilization’s Evolvers.”

“So far, we have conclusively deduced up to the Witch Ancestor Sixteenth Realm cultivation methods,” said the Void God Supreme Being with a smile.

The cultivation methods they deduced were not restricted in any way and should offer considerable aid to human Evolvers in the two-dimensional world.

At the very least, they can serve as a ‘guiding light,’ accelerating the cultivation pace of human civilization Evolvers.

“Alright, I need to go back to instruct those juniors.”

The Xia Qin Supreme Being’s form disappeared.

The other Supreme Beings exchanged glances and gradually vanished as well.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Hmm?”

“Xia Qin Supreme Being wants me to meet him?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, slightly surprised.

In this past century, Xia Qin Supreme Being should have been entangled by some matter and would not usually contact him.

“There must be something,” he thought.

Lin Yuan immediately connected his consciousness to the Virtual World and entered Xia Qin Supreme Being’s Personal World.

“Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan bowed to Xia Qin Supreme Being, who was sitting on the throne.

“Lin Yuan,” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, a smile emerging on his face, “How is your cultivation in the two-dimensional world?”

“Not bad,” Lin Yuan replied.

In just over a hundred years, Lin Yuan had caught up with those at the peak of Tier 11 Legendaries, which was indeed impressive.

Indeed, those who could step into Tier 11 Perfection were beings with heavenly defying talents and attributes, unique and unparalleled in the vast universe.

“Next, I will explain to you the subsequent cultivation methods of the Witch Ancestor,” Xia Qin Supreme Being got straight to the point.

“The Supreme Being explaining the subsequent cultivation methods of the Witch Ancestor?” Lin Yuan was slightly stunned, his face filled with anticipation.

Although unaware of how the Supreme Being deduced the following Witch Ancestor cultivation methods, without entering the two-dimensional world himself and perceiving the essence of the power inside, it was nearly impossible to decipher the specific cultivation methods.

But since Xia Qin Supreme Being said so, he must be very confident.

“The cultivation of the Witch Ancestor period starts from the First Realm…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being quickly outlined the cultivation methods from the First to the Sixth Realm.

“How about this?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan.

“Hmm, could you delve deeper?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment; the methods from the First to the Sixth Realm Xia Qin Supreme Being outlined had indeed given Lin Yuan some insight.

But the impact was not significant, especially since Lin Yuan was already at the Nineteenth Realm of the Witch Ancestor.

The cultivation methods arranged by Deputy Tower Master Nalan had allowed Lin Yuan to break through smoothly to the Nineteenth Realm because of the accumulation of experience, needing only that final push.

Even without the cultivation methods arranged by Nalan, Lin Yuan would have breakthrough to the Nineteenth Realm very soon.

“Delve deeper?” Xia Qin Supreme Being was slightly surprised but did not hesitate and continued to explain the cultivation methods from the Seventh to the Fourteenth Realm of the Witch Ancestor.

“Even deeper, please,” said Lin Yuan after listening, his expression serious, as the methods from the Seventh to the Fourteenth Realm indeed provided him with great insights.

But it was still not enough.

“Deeper still?” Xia Qin Supreme Being’s eyebrows twitched, already at the Fourteenth Realm of the Witch Ancestor, and yet that wasn’t deep enough?

However, since Lin Yuan wanted to hear more in-depth, Xia Qin Supreme Being said nothing further and laid out the ultimate essence of power from the Fifteenth to the Sixteenth Realm of the Witch Ancestor.

“Could we continue a bit deeper?” Lin Yuan, upon hearing this, had some revelations.

“Deeper still?” Xia Qin Supreme Being couldn’t help but say, “What level of cultivation methods are you looking to hear?”

“What level of cultivation methods?” Lin Yuan looked at Xia Qin Supreme Being, “Do you have those of the Witch Ancestor’s Twentieth Realm?”

“The Witch Ancestor’s Twentieth Realm?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being was filled with surprise and doubt, examining Lin Yuan for a while before falling into a deep silence.
